title: Domain Solution Architect – Drug Development
description:
Sandoz continues to go through an exciting and transformative period as a global leader and pioneering provider of sustainable Biosimilar and Generic medicines. As we continue down this new and ambitious path, unique opportunities will present themselves, both professionally and personally. Join us, the future is ours to shape!
  
  
**Job Summary**
The
**Domain Solution Architect – Drug Development**
designs and supports technology solutions across the pharmaceutical R&D lifecycle. This role ensures that digital solutions align with business needs, architectural standards, and regulatory requirements to enable efficient, compliant, and data‑driven drug development.
  
  
Working closely with R&D, Clinical, Regulatory, and IT stakeholders, you will translate scientific and operational needs into scalable solution architectures spanning non‑clinical research, clinical development, regulatory submission support, and R&D platforms (e.g. Veeva Vault, LIMS).
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and document solution architectures supporting drug development and regulatory domains
* Ensure compliance with industry regulations and standards (e.g. GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, data integrity)
* Apply architecture patterns and integration principles to enable interoperable, reusable solutions
* Contribute to domain architecture roadmaps and architectural standards
* Support adoption of digital and data‑driven capabilities, including analytics and automation
* Collaborate across global, cross‑functional teams and vendors

**Required Experience & Skills**

* Experience in solution or domain architecture within pharma or life sciences R&D
* Strong understanding of drug development processes and supporting systems
* Proven delivery experience in regulated environments
* Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks (e.g. TOGAF)
* Strong stakeholder engagement, influencing, and consulting skills
* Comfortable working in complex, evolving, and highly regulated contexts

**Preferred Requirements**

* Managing resources.
* Creativity and visioning.
* Emerging Technology Monitoring.
* Consulting.
* IT Governance.
* IT Enterprise & Business Architecture.
* IT Solution Architecture.
* IT Technical Strategy & Planning.
* Performance Management.
* Influencing and persuading.

**Why Sandoz?**
Generic and Biosimilar medicines are the backbone of the global medicines industry. Sandoz, a leader in this sector, provided more than 900 million patient treatments across 100+ countries in 2024 and while we are proud of this achievement, we have an ambition to do more!
  
  
With investments in new development capabilities, production sites, new acquisitions, and partnerships, we have the opportunity to shape the future of Sandoz and help more patients gain access to low-cost, high-quality medicines, sustainably.
  
  
Our momentum is powered by an open, collaborative culture driven by our talented and ambitious colleagues, who, in return for applying their skills experience an agile and collegiate environment with impactful, flexible-hybrid careers, where diversity is welcomed and where personal growth is supported!
  
  
**Join us!**
**#Sandoz**

title: Team Lead - Software Engineering
description:
**About Us**
Zelis is modernizing the healthcare financial experience in the United States (U.S.) across payers, providers, and healthcare consumers. We serve more than 750 payers, including the top five national health plans, regional health plans, TPAs and millions of healthcare providers and consumers across our platform of solutions. Zelis sees across the system to identify, optimize, and solve problems holistically with technology built by healthcare experts – driving real, measurable results for clients.
  
  
At Zelis, AI is woven into the fabric of how we work. Every associate is expected - and empowered - to partner with AI to challenge the status quo, accelerate innovation, and amplify their impact. This is a place for builders with a growth mindset who act with agility, embrace change, and use modern technology to shape smarter solutions, exceptional experiences, and the future of our industry for our clients, customers, and our culture.
  
  
**Why We Do What We Do**
In the U.S., consumers, payers, and providers face significant challenges throughout the healthcare financial journey. Zelis helps streamline the process by offering solutions that improve transparency, efficiency, and communication among all parties involved. By addressing the obstacles that patients face in accessing care, navigating the intricacies of insurance claims, and the logistical challenges healthcare providers encounter with processing payments, Zelis aims to create a more seamless and effective healthcare financial system.
  
  
Zelis India plays a crucial role in this mission by supporting various initiatives that enhance the healthcare financial experience. The local team contributes to the development and implementation of innovative solutions, ensuring that technology and processes are optimized for efficiency and effectiveness. Beyond operational expertise, Zelis India cultivates a collaborative work culture, leadership development, and global exposure, creating a dynamic environment for professional growth. With hybrid work flexibility, comprehensive healthcare benefits, financial wellness programs, and cultural celebrations, we foster a holistic workplace experience. Additionally, the team plays a vital role in maintaining high standards of service delivery and contributes to Zelis’ award-winning culture.
  
  
**Position Overview**
We are seeking a .NET Lead – Payments to drive the design, development, and delivery of mission-critical payment systems. This role combines hands-on technical leadership, architectural ownership, and team mentoring, with a strong focus on secure, scalable, and compliant payment solutions.
  
  
You will work closely with product, architecture, compliance, QA, and DevOps teams to build resilient payment services that operate at scale.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Technical Leadership
  
  
Lead the end-to-end development of payment processing systems using the .NET stack
  
  
Own system architecture and technical design for payment services and APIs
  
  
Ensure high availability, fault tolerance, and performance for transaction-heavy systems
  
  
Drive adoption of best practices (SOLID, clean architecture, domain-driven design)
  
  
Payments & Domain Ownership
  
  
Design and implement payment workflows, settlements, reconciliations, and exception handling
  
  
Handle high-volume, low-latency transaction processing
  
  
Ensure idempotency, retries, and transactional consistency
  
  
Collaborate with business teams on payments rules, validations, and edge cases
  
  
Security & Compliance
  
  
Ensure compliance with PCI-DSS, HIPAA, and internal security standards
  
  
Implement secure authentication and authorization (OAuth2, JWT, role-based access)
  
  
Partner with security teams on audits, vulnerability remediation, and data protection
  
  
Mentorship & Collaboration
  
  
Lead and mentor a team of senior and mid-level engineers
  
  
Conduct code reviews and enforce coding standards
  
  
Participate in sprint planning, estimation, and delivery commitments
  
  
Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, QA, SRE, and Compliance
  
  
**Required Technical Skills**
Core Technologies
  
  
Strong expertise in C#, .NET Core / .NET 6+
  
  
ASP.NET Core Web APIs & Microservices
  
  
RESTful services and event-driven architectures
  
  
Payments & Data
  
  
Strong SQL Server experience (complex queries, performance tuning)
  
  
Experience with financial transactions and data consistency
  
  
Knowledge of reconciliation and reporting systems
  
  
Cloud & DevOps
  
  
Azure ecosystem (App Services, Functions, Service Bus, Storage, Key Vault)
  
  
CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions)
  
  
Experience with Docker; Kubernetes is a plus
  
  
Architecture & Patterns
  
  
Microservices architecture
  
  
Domain-Driven Design (DDD)
  
  
Messaging & eventing (Service Bus, Kafka, or equivalent)
  
  
Caching strategies (Redis)
  
  
**Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging**
At Zelis, we champion diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging in all aspects of our operations. We embrace the power of diversity and create an environment where people can bring their authentic and best selves to work. We know that a sense of belonging is key not only to your success at Zelis, but also to your ability to bring your best each day.
  
  
**Equal Employment Opportunity**
Zelis is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.
  
  
**Accessibility Support**
We are dedicated to ensuring our application process is accessible to all candidates. If you are a qualified individual with a disability and require reasonable accommodation with any part of the application and/or interview process, please email talentacquisition@zelis.com.

title: Manager II, Tech(AI)
description:
**Overview**
 BEST is modernizing our data capabilities to accelerate product innovation, data\-driven decision making, and AI\-enabled experiences. Today the organization operates with traditional data engineering practices; we are hiring a transformation leader who will modernize the platform, build production\-grade ML/AI capabilities, and embed responsible AI across the business.
   

  

 We’re hiring a strategic, hands\-on
 **Sr. Manager, Data Services** 
 to own and scale BEST’s data platform and teams—leading engineers and managers across ingestion, transformation, platform services, data products/APIs, governance, and production ML/AI. You’ll be accountable for MLOps, model serving, and the people/processes to safely operationalize AI at scale, transforming a traditional data\-engineering function into an AI\-first, product\-oriented organization. This role requires deep technical expertise in data platforms, MLOps and LLM/AI patterns, plus proven people leadership and cross\-functional influence.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Strategy \& Roadmap — Define and operationalize a 12–24 month roadmap for Data Services that supports company data and AI goals (data APIs, platform, governance, ML pipelines, model serving and monitoring).
* Team Leadership — Hire, mentor and grow a high\-performing team (data engineers, platform engineers, ML engineers, SREs). Build leadership bench and establish clear career paths.
* Data Platform Ownership — Own the design, delivery, and run\-book for data platforms (data lake/warehouse, streaming, ingestion, processing, metadata/catalog, lineage and observability).
* ML/AI Enablement — Partner with AI/ML teams to build repeatable ML pipelines and production model serving (batch \& real\-time). Lead MLOps adoption: model training, deployment, CI/CD, drift detection, and model governance.
* AI Productionization — Drive production\-grade implementations of AI use\-cases (including large language models, retrieval\-augmented generation, knowledge graphs, agentic/automated workflows). Ensure safe, scalable, and cost\-efficient model serving and inference.
* Data Products \& APIs — Deliver production data products and APIs consumed by analytics, product teams, and AI systems. Enable self\-service data and ML capabilities for downstream teams.
* Quality, Observability \& Governance — Implement enterprise\-grade data quality, lineage, cataloging, access controls, and privacy/compliance practices. Partner with security and legal on policy for AI model usage and data privacy.
* Stakeholder Management — Work cross\-functionally with product, engineering, marketing, sales, and COE to translate business needs into data and AI programs, prioritizing high\-impact work and measuring outcomes.
* Metrics \& Outcomes — Define and report KPIs for platform reliability, time\-to\-insight, model accuracy/performance, cost, and adoption.


**Qualifications**
* 12\+ years’ experience in data engineering, data platform, analytics, or ML engineering roles, with at least 3\+ years in a people\-/team\-management role.
* Hands\-on experience building and operating large\-scale data platforms (data lakes/warehouses, Spark/Databricks, Snowflake/Redshift/BigQuery, streaming with Kafka/Kinesis).
* Demonstrated track record of taking ML/AI projects from POC to production. Practical experience with MLOps tooling and pipelines (e.g., MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, or equivalent).
* Deep familiarity with model serving and inference architectures (real\-time and batch), model monitoring, automated retraining, and drift detection.
* Strong engineering skills: Python / SQL (and/or Scala/Java), data pipeline frameworks, and versioned data/model workflows.
* Experience with LLMs and modern AI application patterns: prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), knowledge graphs, LLM safety/guardrails, and LLMOps frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex).
* Cloud platform experience (AWS / Azure / GCP) and experience designing cost\-efficient, production\-grade ML inference at scale.
* Experience with data governance, cataloging (Amundsen/Atlas/Data Catalog), lineage and privacy compliance (GDPR/CCPA) in a production environment.
* Excellent people and cross\-functional leadership skills, with strong communication, stakeholder influence, and program management ability.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or related field. Advanced degree (MS/PhD) in a quantitative or engineering discipline preferred.

title: Global Senior Domain Solution Architect Enterprise Platforms
description:
Sandoz continues to go through an exciting and transformative period as a global leader and pioneering provider of sustainable Biosimilar and Generic medicines. As we continue down this new and ambitious path, unique opportunities will present themselves, both professionally and personally. Join us, the future is ours to shape!
   

  

 We are looking for a Global Senior Domain Solution Architect, Enterprise Platforms, to lead the architecture and evolution of shared technology platforms that enable enterprise workflow, automation, cloud\-native application capabilities, DevOps, IT service management, and reusable cross\-functional services. This role ensures enterprise platforms are scalable, secure, compliant, cost\-efficient, and aligned with business strategy and enterprise architecture principles.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 Your responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
   

  

* Contribute to the development and evolution of the target architecture, technology roadmap, and reusable architecture standards for shared enterprise platforms, including workflow and service management, automation, DevOps, low\-code/no\-code, cloud platform services, and other reusable technology capabilities.
* Develop solution architectures for the implementation, modernization, consolidation, integration, and continuous evolution of platforms within the Enterprise Platforms domain.
* Deliver architecture services, governance activities, architecture modeling, and documentation across global programs, projects, product teams, and platform initiatives, including conceptual and logical architectures, platform blueprints, capability maps, technology standards, and architecture decision records.
* Define and apply reusable architecture patterns, principles, standards, and reference architectures to improve platform consistency, interoperability, scalability, reuse, and long\-term maintainability.
* Evaluate platform capabilities, identify technology gaps and functional overlaps, and provide recommendations regarding platform adoption, modernization, consolidation, rationalization, or retirement.
* Support platform ownership and product teams in defining platform boundaries, shared services, technology roadmaps, lifecycle strategies, and non\-functional requirements while promoting platform reuse, standardization, automation, and self\-service capabilities.
* Ensure platform architectures meet enterprise requirements for cybersecurity, data privacy, resilience, availability, business continuity, disaster recovery, GxP, and other applicable regulatory, quality, and compliance frameworks.
* Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture, Security, Infrastructure and Cloud, Data and Analytics, Integration, SAP, business application teams, vendors, and implementation partners to ensure architectural alignment, validate platform capabilities, and advise on emerging technologies and platform innovations relevant to Sandoz.


**Key Performance Indicator**
* Consistent, well\-governed, secure, resilient, and cost\-effective enterprise platform architectures supported by documented target architectures, technology roadmaps, standards, reusable architecture patterns, increased platform reuse and standardization, reduced technology duplication, and clearly defined ownership boundaries.


**Essential Requirements**
**What You'll Bring to the Role:**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field; master's degree preferred.
* 5\+ years of IT experience, including experience in solution, platform, domain, or enterprise architecture roles.
* Experience designing, governing, or evolving shared enterprise technology platforms within complex global organizations.
* Practical experience with enterprise platform technologies, including IT service management, enterprise workflow, automation, low\-code/no\-code, DevOps, cloud application platforms, container platforms, and developer enablement capabilities.
* Strong understanding of cloud architecture concepts, including platform\-as\-a\-service, container orchestration, cloud\-native application services, identity and access management, observability, resilience, shared cloud services, and hybrid technology environments.
* Understanding of DevOps and software delivery capabilities, including source code management, CI/CD, artifact management, automated testing, infrastructure as code, platform engineering practices, and modern application delivery approaches.
* Ability to define platform boundaries, identify capability overlaps, translate business and technology requirements into scalable platform architectures and roadmaps, and apply architecture tools and modeling techniques such as ArchiMate, UML, BPMN, and SAP LeanIX.
* Knowledge of non\-functional architecture requirements, including cybersecurity, privacy, availability, performance, scalability, interoperability, business continuity, disaster recovery, supportability, applicable regulatory and quality frameworks (including GxP, data integrity, data privacy, and computerized system lifecycle requirements), combined with strong consulting, stakeholder management, communication, and enterprise architecture skills; fluent in English.


**Desirable Requirements**
* Experience working across SaaS, PaaS, cloud, and on\-premises environments, collaborating with application, data, integration, security, infrastructure, and operations teams.
* Experience in pharmaceutical, biotech, life sciences, or other highly regulated industries.


**You'll Receive**
* Competitive compensation and benefits package.
* Flexible and hybrid working opportunities.
* Ongoing learning, professional development, and certification support.
* Exposure to global security and technology initiatives.
* Career growth opportunities within a dynamic and evolving global organization.
* An inclusive, collaborative, and purpose\-driven work environment.


**Why Sandoz?**
 Generic and Biosimilar medicines are the backbone of the global medicines industry. Sandoz, a leader in this sector, provided more than 900 million patient treatments across 100\+ countries in 2024 and while we are proud of this achievement, we have an ambition to do more!
   

  

 With investments in new development capabilities, production sites, new acquisitions, and partnerships, we have the opportunity to shape the future of Sandoz and help more patients gain access to low\-cost, high\-quality medicines, sustainably.
   

  

 Our momentum is powered by an open, collaborative culture driven by our talented and ambitious colleagues, who, in return for applying their skills experience an agile and collegiate environment with impactful, flexible\-hybrid careers, where diversity is welcomed and where personal growth is supported!
   

  

**Join us!**
